title: Lightweight Auth Boundaries
implementation_notes: All phases 1-10 implemented. Auth core with Role enum, PBKDF2 calibration, AuthStore, SessionStore with TTL, CSRF protection (basic and expert/admin), LoginAttemptLimiter, provisioning CLI (tools/auth_setup.py), middleware integration, auth endpoints (/auth/login, /auth/logout, /auth/whoami, /auth/step-up), auth gates in webserver.py, route policy classification. Full test coverage in test_auth.py, test_auth_middleware.py, test_auth_limiter.py, test_auth_setup.py, test_webserver_auth.py.
